subject.title: Feature: Opt-in cross-channel visibility in TUI (mirror iMessage/Telegram activity)

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class TUI observe/mirror mode for activity from other channel sessions, and should it be read-only, interactive, or limited to explicitly selected sessions?
rationale: This crosses session and channel boundaries, likely adds CLI/config surface, and changes privacy/message-delivery expectations; source inspection can prove the gap but cannot choose the product boundary.

options.title: Read-only observe mode
options.body: Add an explicit observe mode that displays authorized cross-channel activity without sending mirrored replies to other transports.

options.title: Interactive mirror mode
options.body: Allow bidirectional visible mirroring between TUI and channels behind a stronger opt-in, accepting higher delivery and privacy risk.

options.title: No broad mirror mode
options.body: Limit core work to selected-session live updates and leave broader monitoring to logs or future design.

recommendation.title: Read-only observe mode
recommendation.body: Add an explicit observe mode that displays authorized cross-channel activity without sending mirrored replies to other transports.

likelyOwner.reason: They are carrying the current related TUI live-session implementation and have the strongest follow-up signal for the session-refresh boundary.
